citation: Karnataka State Natural Disaster Monitoring Centre (KSNDMC), annual rainfall district dataset for 2024, distributed by OpenCity.

name: WaterMap district proxy estimates v1 (not observed data)
description: Explicitly estimated piped-supply stress, tanker reliance, and water-body stress proxies derived from source-backed groundwater extraction stage, rainfall deficit, and documented district archetype assumptions. citation: WaterMap model estimate v1; formulas and assumptions are documented in backend/data/raw/DISTRICT_METRICS_METHODOLOGY.md. Underlying source inputs: CGWB/GWD GWRA 2024 and KSNDMC 2024 rainfall.
